product.name: Class & Appointment Scheduling
product.description: A platform to manage online and in-person bookings for classes and appointments, including memberships and packs creation, staff and venue management, and website schedule embedding.

identifier.value: Inbox (Two-way SMS, Email, and In-App Messaging)

product.name: Inbox (Two-way SMS, Email, and In-App Messaging)
product.description: A unified communication inbox that consolidates two-way SMS, email, and in-app messaging for customer interactions and outreach.

product.name: Automations (Sequences)
product.description: A tool to create automated sequences for customer communication, client interactions, and staff task management to improve lead conversion and customer retention.

product.name: Point of Sale (POS)
product.description: A system for managing in-person sales, including payment processing with a contactless card reader and retail product inventory tracking.

product.name: Staff Management
product.description: Tools to manage staff roles, permissions, clock-ins, payroll reports, and automate instructor substitutions.

product.name: Reporting and Analytics
product.description: A reporting system offering visualized insights and detailed metrics on sales, payroll, customer conversion, and other business KPIs.
